caption_v7: \caption{\textbf{Neighbor agreement changes with the evaluation size at a rate set by the model pair, and spanning-tree overlap tracks one-nearest-neighbor overlap (Theorem~\ref{thm:crossing}, Proposition~\ref{prop:mst}).} (a) mKNN against $m$ for single pairs (thin) and class medians (thick). (b) Class medians at three values of $k$ against $k/m$, on the scale of (a). Coincident curves show agreement set by $k/m$ alone. (c) Vision--language pairs of WIT at two depths. Appendices~\ref{app:exp-s11} and~\ref{app:exp-s12} give the details.}

caption_v7_words.how: each \ref and each inline formula is one word; panel labels (a) (b) (c) at sentence starts counted in the first total only

caption_v6: \caption{\textbf{Neighbor agreement changes with the evaluation size at a rate set by the pair of models, and spanning-tree overlap tracks one-nearest-neighbor overlap (Theorem~\ref{thm:crossing}, Proposition~\ref{prop:mst}).} (a) mKNN $s_N$ at $k=10$ and mid depth against the evaluation size $m$ on nested COCO pools, for single pairs (thin), class medians (thick), and chance $k/(m-1)$ (dashed). A pair joins two Pythia-410M runs trained with different seeds (seed), two vision models (vision), or a vision and a language model (vision--language). Numbers at the right give the median slope of $\ln s_N$ on $\ln m$ in each class. (b) The class medians against $k/m$ for three values of $k$, sharing the vertical axis of (a), with the medians of (a) as squares. The closer the markers of a class lie to one curve, the more its agreement depends on $k/m$ alone. (c) MST overlap against one-nearest-neighbor overlap on WIT for every vision--language pair of Section~\ref{sec:exp-protocol}, at mid depth (open) and the last layer (filled). The bound of Proposition~\ref{prop:mst} (solid) excludes the grey region, and the dotted line is the diagonal. Panels (a, b) are descriptive; Figure~\ref{fig:exp-scale} compares them with the crossing law, and Figure~\ref{fig:exp-mst} adds the forest share and the bridges.}
caption_v8: \caption{\textbf{Neighbor agreement changes with the evaluation size at a rate set by the model pair, and spanning-tree overlap tracks one-nearest-neighbor overlap (Theorem~\ref{thm:crossing}, Proposition~\ref{prop:mst}).} (a) mKNN on nested COCO pools against $m$, for single pairs (thin) and class medians (thick). (b) Class medians at three values of $k$ against $k/m$, on the scale of (a). Coincident curves show agreement set by $k/m$ alone. (c) Vision--language pairs of WIT at two depths. Appendices~\ref{app:exp-s11} and~\ref{app:exp-s12} give the details.}
